checks.assessment: Equal-room macro MAE, median, worst room and all seven paired room outcomes are reported; no inference from pooled rows alone.
Seven selected development rooms do not establish accuracy across 476 rooms; no accuracy percentage inferred from R-squared.
Representative-room selection and previously examined development data limit external validity; TEST remains sealed.
No outcome-dependent feature filtering or held-room target calibration; inputs are the original 13 predictors.
All seven rooms and 122640 outer rows remain; two improved, one tied, four worsened. Small low-light errors remain visible.
Improvement in an extreme room is not treated as evidence of overall or causal improvement.
All weights and rooms are reported, including BM432 deterioration and the failed development gate.
Five declared weights only; no significance tests, post-hoc finer grid or room-specific routing.
Original-unit macro MAE and the prespecified gate determine the decision. Improved secondary asinh MAE does not override failure.
Weight-selection transfer failure is observed; missing geometry remains a hypothesis, not a proven physical cause.
Held-room labels are used only for scoring. Weight selection uses inner OOF on the other six rooms; diagnostic true-label substitutions are not inference inputs.

selection_score_limit: The same inner OOF supports formulation-candidate and blend-weight selection; these inner scores are selection evidence, not independent performance estimates.
